corrections.original: Every Circuit builder method (affine, reglu, boolean, indexRead, multiply, select, constant) ends in Circuit.append, which pushes one Operation and returns wire sourceSize + operations.length (key claim 6; dossier section 1).
corrections.fix: affine, constant (via affine), roundAffine, reglu, boolean, multiply and select end in Circuit.append; indexRead does not: it calls indexReadAffine, which pushes its own 'index' operation (append's kind excludes 'index') or returns a candidate wire for a constant index. multiply with unknown-sign operands appends 3 operations and select up to 4, so one call = one operation only for affine/reglu/boolean. Branded Wire, the returned wire number and the identity/duplicate-expression short-circuits are confirmed.

corrections.original: table.createCircuit (new Circuit(cells.length) with every range, grid, bit and one-hot declared) (key claim 5).
corrections.fix: Clarified: one-hot groups are declared to the circuit only when declareToCircuit is set (the default); table.atMostOne rules are validator-only. The rest of the two-phase sequence and finish() returning {circuit, nextSource, initialSource, validate} is confirmed.
